read_boxes.title: Scale-led profiles
read_boxes.text: C1 and C3 have run teams at or above the size this role needs, with records of hitting plan year after year. The question for both is fit: C1 would relocate from Boston, and C3 has always had a large company's process behind them.

read_boxes.title: Buyer-led profile
read_boxes.text: C2 sells to finance and operations leaders today, the same buyer this company serves, and is local. The trade-off is the move back from services to software.

focus_next: C2 remains our top candidate, with C1 and C3 close behind. We are moving C1 to a second screen focused on relocation and continuing to advance C4 as a longer-term option.
